risk_surfaces.reason: Generic public creation must not translate planning or cash into the economic event.
Public date combinations must reject missing/invalid semantic inputs.
Existing deterministic reconciliation transition parity remains required.
Existing transfer reconciliation parity remains required.
Grouped member edits must keep temporal facts independent.
Void and reactivation state changes must not invent cash facts.
Realized reports must remain assigned by occurredOn after edits.
Reactivation must place new cash effect on the transition date, not a historical source date.
Import reconciliation must preserve economic/planned history.
Voiding realized history must preserve the historical cash-effect date.
Consumers must not use one universal temporal precedence.
The official manual producer must explicitly source the economic event.
Canonical docs must define source, destination, transitions and fallbacks consistently.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A public, specialized or UI producer collapses independent temporal facts, or a state transition fabricates a cash date, while ordinary happy paths still look correct.

negative_controls.failure_mode: A semantically distinct temporal fact is overwritten, fabricated, or routed to the wrong destination.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: A generic POST adapter falls back from missing occurredOn to plannedOn or effectiveOn, creating a new record with false economic history.
negative_controls.procedure: Inspect the exact material mapper and its discriminant source test for planned-only and effective-only bodies.
negative_controls.expected: Missing occurredOn remains missing/invalid; other temporal fields never fabricate it.
negative_controls.observed: Static source inspection shows only body.occurredOn is accepted; missing/null map to empty and existing domain validation rejects empty dates.
